Argentina Files Criminal Case Against Oil Firm Over Falklands Operations

Argentina is initiating a criminal case against an oil company operating in the Falkland Islands. This action follows President Javier Milei's recent efforts to assert Argentina's sovereignty claims over the islands. Separately, an Israeli minister urged his government to support Argentina's claim to the Falklands, suggesting the UK should end its "occupation."
